prose: build_inspector's encapsulation_holds (inspector.py:4770) and no_iou_stands (inspector.py:5178) take the census root's parent as the repo without checking that the census root is <repo>/cairn. When it is not, they walk whatever directory contains it. Measured 2026-11-16 on ticket 6ea3a8548493: a test_transitions fixture at /tmp/tmpXXX/<name> made the repo /tmp, and import_sites AST-parsed 13,947 foreign .py files per gated crossing, ~97 s each (283 of 287 s in encapsulation_holds under cProfile). The proof was fixed by moving its fixture; the inspector still reads a non-repo as a repo. inspector.py:4196 already guards the same derivation with `root.parent if root.name == "cairn" else root`.
